title: Fast-Growing Company Flock is Building a New AI-Driven Mass-Surveillance System | American Civil Liberties Union
summary: An ACLU report by Jay Stanley examines how Flock Safety is building a nationwide ALPR-based mass surveillance network by selling cameras to HOAs, private parties, and police, and aggregating data centrally. The report warns about Flock's expansion into broader video surveillance and AI machine vision.

key_quotes.quote: A new and rapidly growing surveillance company called Flock Safety is building a form of mass surveillance unlike any seen before in American life.
a business model that effectively enlists its customers into a giant centralized government surveillance network
